title: Post by elev8ted.path
description:
Most people don't actually learn.

They just memorize information… and forget it days later.

Want to learn faster and remember almost everything you study?

Use the Feynman Technique.

Here are the 4 steps to master any topic faster:

1. Choose one concept and write down everything you already know.

2. Explain it in simple words as if teaching a 10-year-old.

3. Find the gaps, revisit the source, and simplify your explanation.

4. Test yourself by teaching someone else without your notes.

Knowledge isn't proven by memorizing.

It's proven by explaining.

If you can't explain it simply…

You don't understand it deeply enough.

What's one skill or subject you're learning right now?

Save this post and use this framework every time you study.
